meta.title: ChonkyFish · Little Fish Pond Console
meta.description: ChonkyFish — a self-contained panel backed by a real DSH session under the 'chonkyfish' agent preset: chat with a chubby cartoon whale, tune her name and extra persona, keep her pocket-money ledger, and let the Host make her speak first inside the current panel conversation (capability only, no timers). All plugin data lives in its own home ($DSH_HOME/chonkyfish/). Installing it also tints the whole Harness with the little-pond palette in light and dark mode.
